messages:
aden: FYI vendor-zenith just pinged: Rotterdam terminals went into a 24h staggered slowdown, our H200 tranche eta is slipping. Potential knock-on for EU capacity pools.
aden: We have 12 H200s earmarked for pool-eu-core (RMA replacements + top-off). Any ops/finance input on charter vs split-air?
vendor-zenith: Confirmed: terminal congestion + labour rotation at RTM. Options: 1) overnight air-charter for 6 highest-priority units (approx +18k per charter, clears quicker) or 2) break into two LCL air shipments to AMS/FRA (cheaper ~+8% freight but needs rework at arrival). Both require updated AWB manifests and serial mapping.
sophie: What's the insurance delta on air-charter vs LCL? also what's the lead time to get return labels attached for DOA swap that we flagged?
vendor-zenith: Air-charter: insurance uplift +1.2% declared, door-to-door ~30h. LCL split-air: insurance +0.5%, door-to-door 48	6h depending on customs. Return labels: we can pre-generate up to 10 RMA labels and inject into the manifest reference field.
ops-bot: Ticket created: ZEN-2024-8110 - "RTM slowdown -> H200 tranche routing decision". Assigned: @aden, @sophie, vendor-zenith.
aden: We prefer minimizing cost but need latency for the 4 units serving live infra (pool-eu-core). Proposal: charter 4 priority H200s, LCL rest. Can vendor-zenith confirm serial list for chartered units only?
vendor-zenith: We can. Charter manifest will include serials and REDWOOD-RMA tag in ref. Preliminary AWB for charter: AWB: 620-5550123. We'll attach serials file within 2h.
customs-bot: Note: EU entry from NL via air requires ECCN declaration on the commercial invoice. If value-per-unit > $30k, notify customs for pre-clear to avoid hold.
sophie: Thanks customs-bot. Aden, also need a PO amendment for the charter add cost. PO# 2024-9120? finance needs a line item for expedited freight.
aden: (typo) aden: yes PO# 2024-9120. Finance: please expect addendum.
vendor-zenith: Adding RMA return labels for 5 flagged DOAs. Labels will be printed and linked in portal: https://vendor.zenith.example.com/rma/labels?ref=REDWOOD-2024-9120 
vendor-zenith: Serial list preview (charter):
```
H200-SN: ZN87654321, ZN87654322, ZN87654323, ZN87654324
```
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 6h follow-up on ZEN-2024-8110
sophie: Once AWBs are uploaded, ops will run the reassign script to pin units to pool-eu-core. Command:
```
# pin chartered replacements to pool-eu-core
python ops/pin_allocs.py --pool pool-eu-core --tag REDWOOD-RMA --awbs 620-5550123
```
aden: One more ask: for the LCL rest, can vendor-zenith provide depot handover SOP and crate fork dims? Facilities booking needs dims for FRA and AMS.
vendor-zenith: Will provide crate dims and forklift requirements in doc package. FRA dock window caution: peak period next 48h, please book early.
sophie: Decision: approve charter for 4 units (confirm). LCL for remaining 8. Vendor please send invoice addendum (charter line + insurance delta + handling). We also require vendor credit for any serial mismatch >1 unit on arrival.
vendor-zenith: Understood. Invoice addendum and AWB/serial upload in ~90m. We'll include REDWOOD-RMA in manifest refs and return label links.
aden: Thanks. Keep thread updated. If customs holds happen, vendor propose diversion to MUC air-hub as fallback (similar transit/time).
vendor-zenith: Noted - MUC fallback accepted, additional cost delta ~+3% vs FRA.
ops-bot: Update logged: ZEN-2024-8110 status=awaiting-docs.
sophie: cheers, will monitor. :thumbsup:
